input: existing usable stride-30 windows; 30 scaled consumption values only

logistic_unweighted.standardization: StandardScaler fitted on training windows only

logistic_balanced.standardization: StandardScaler fitted on training windows only

imbalance_policy: compare unweighted and balanced class weights; no resampling
customer_aggregation: arithmetic mean of usable-window predicted probabilities
customer_threshold_policy: maximize positive-class F1 on validation customer means
selection_policy: highest validation window ROC-AUC, then window average precision, among non-dummy models; no test information
test_policy: Stages 6, 8, 10, and 12 establish one frozen test evaluation after validation-only selection. Stage 13 follows that policy for the selected supervised model only.
